name: Welcome
what: The first screen, unchanged: the lamp, the name, one line on what runs where.

name: What do you want to do?
what: Pick any of seven groups. Chat starts picked; picking a group picks its first feature.

versions.label: Built to the design doc
versions.what: The living background shows through; tiles use the design tokens and fill the width; the block sits centred above the footer.

name: Which ones?
what: The features of each picked group, a column per group. A picked Pro feature brings the license key box.

versions.label: Built to the design doc
versions.what: Columns fill the width; the license key box sits under them instead of under the title.

name: How it works: Chat
what: The guide, filtered to the picks. Where models run and the analytics opt-in sit under Your picks.

versions.label: Built to the design doc
versions.what: One emerald action (Set up my models); the settings moved under Your picks so the guide gets the right side.

name: How it works: a Pro feature
what: A Pro pick shows the price, Get Pro and Enter license key under it.

versions.label: Built to the design doc
versions.what: Get Pro is outline now, so Set up my models stays the one primary action.

name: How it works: Connectors
what: Connectors shows the connections inline (the old Connect step), still optional.

name: After setup: models
what: Set up my models hands off to model setup as today, with the picks saved. Step 5 makes it use them.
